  General explanation of how the meeting is conducted:
  1. The staff report is presented by City staff.
  2. The City Art in Public Places Advisory Committee (APPAC) ask questions if necessary for
  clarification.
  3. The applicant makes a presentation to the City APPAC.
  4. Individuals speaking in favor or opposition of the project address the City APPAC.
  5. The applicant responds to project comments.
  6. City APPAC members discuss the project.
  7. City APPAC members vote on the project.
  8. The project is forwarded to the City Council for final decision (unless directed otherwise).
